strc.name: Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock

facts.value: STRC is preferred equity, distinct from MSTR common stock. The certificate provides dividend, liquidation and conditional repurchase rights, not a claim to withdraw a share of corporate bitcoin reserves.

STRC has no sinking-fund obligation. Issuer redemption is governed by Section 7; the holder fundamental-change repurchase right in Section 8 is subject to its procedures and legally available funds. No ordinary holder demand-redemption at par is established.
Section 9 denies general voting rights except specified certificate/statutory rights; materially adverse specified changes require holder consent, subject to stated exceptions.
The filed certificate was adopted under Delaware General Corporation Law Section 242. This is the corporate-law instrument; a complete dispute/forum and access analysis was not performed.

October 29 filing states certificate filing and an effective time of November 1, 2026 00:01 Eastern. The certificate defines November 3 as the first new regular payment date and excludes November 2 under the new terms. This is filed legal scheduling evidence, not confirmation of actual payment or wrapper pass-through.
